payload.name: Stubs Fail and Never Fabricate
payload.description: An arm that cannot really compute fails explicitly and stays in the code. It never returns invented values and is not deleted. Work that depends on other modalities is left as it is.

principles.name: Failure is honest, a fake is not
principles.description: A mock result passes for a real one downstream; an explicit failure does not.

heuristics.condition: a comment says 'simulate', 'mock' or 'placeholder' above returned data
heuristics.action: replace the data with a failure

heuristics.condition: a result is flagged valid but has an empty payload (zero vertices, empty file)
heuristics.action: treat it as a failure, not a success

decision_rules.name: Fail instead of simulating
decision_rules.condition: an arm has no real implementation
decision_rules.outcome: make it return an explicit failure with a clear reason, never a simulated or constant result

decision_rules.name: Keep the stub
decision_rules.condition: an arm is found to be fabricated
decision_rules.outcome: do not delete it; leave it in place as a failing arm and list it as pending work

decision_rules.name: Leave dependent work alone
decision_rules.condition: an arm depends on another modality
decision_rules.outcome: leave it as it is, still failing, until the dependency is real

decision_rules.name: Verify values differ
decision_rules.condition: a result is described as analysis
decision_rules.outcome: compare outputs across different inputs to show they are not constants
